title: What If the Moon Disappeared Tonight? 🌙
description:
The Moon vanishes. What happens to Earth?
Tides shrink to about a third, coral reefs lose their calendar, and over millions of years Earth's tilt could start to wander.

What should we make disappear next? Tell us in the comments.

#shorts #space #science #moon #whatif
facts_checked: Moon causes most of Earth's tides; solar tide alone is roughly a third to half of lunar
Many corals time mass spawning to the lunar cycle
The Moon stabilises Earth's axial tilt; Mars' obliquity varies chaotically over millions of years
No Moon means no solar eclipses
